title: Textual Training for the Hassle-Free Removal of Unwanted Visual Data : Case Studies on OOD and Hateful Image Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) and hateful visual content to aid in data curation. While it uses a dataset containing antisemitic and islamophobic imagery for testing purposes, the study's objective is the performance of a detection algorithm (HFTT) rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
